comparison.objective: Place two setting blocks, then lower and release a glass unit into a frame channel without sill contact.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual block placement and controlled large-panel alignment/descent; no tool-driven parameter adjustment or dynamic commissioning.
comparison.success_condition: Glass rests on both positioned blocks, centred and stable, without ever touching the sill. Candidate instead requires two acceptable impact cycles after collar adjustment and setscrew locking.
comparison.reason: Support placement and collision-free glazing test a different ability from tuning and mechanically locking a shock absorber based on dynamic response. Candidate rubric omits numeric limits for excessive rebound, overload, hard-stop clearance, and allowed post-lock collar drift, but those omissions do not create plausible overlap.
